description: Ulice města is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Město Bohumín. Dial of God's streets. Coverage: Město Bohumín. The portal shows the English title as "Streets of the city" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Město Bohumín. Its keywords include ulice, Bohumín. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00297569/3386358/distribuce/98d863604cb697fc4cf12cf295493d91/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
